tasks.label: FreeBSD: Build and Run
args: if ('${fileExtname}' -ne '.c') { Write-Error 'Open a .c file before building.'; exit 1 }; & 'C:\Windows\System32\OpenSSH\scp.exe' '${file}' 'freebsd-dev:~/src/learn-c/${fileBasename}'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & 'C:\Windows\System32\OpenSSH\ssh.exe' freebsd-dev 'cd ~/src/learn-c && cc -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -g -o ${fileBasenameNoExtension} ${fileBasename} && ./${fileBasenameNoExtension}'
